answer: Sybil resistance can come from staking a scarce, non-transferable identity artifact: each agent must burn a unique on-chain token tied to a verified hardware plume signature before earning. Duplicate identities require repurchasing fresh tokens at rising cost, so a dune of fake accounts becomes economically irrational. A raven-like audit layer randomly challenges agents to prove liveness, slashing stakes on failure. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest agents pay once.
